arStrings.szText: A memento of sacrifice. A vigil of vengeance.

Petros' madness secured his own cursed fate. Now only Mikkos remains. 

Petros' blood now carries the urn back to its creator. Following the trail, Oracle Cyra and I will find Achaia and put an end to the urns' curse before it claims its final victim.

Petros' blood led us to Achaia's hidden refuge within the ruins of Philios. She can hide no longer. 

Oracle Cyra and I will see fate returned to its owners.

Achaia has been silenced and her curse with her. I must return to Mikkos to assure he is free from the cursed urn—his fate his own, once more.

Mikkos' urn is no longer cursed, its image cleared of his ill fate. Achaia's curse died with her.
